# The Wringer

> Turn vague AI agent ideas into checkable work orders, then audit or execute them.

The Wringer is a paid web tool at https://www.thewringer.ai. It turns plain English into a
structured work order (goal, checkable acceptance criteria, boundaries), then offers two paid
actions:

- **$1 Audit**: stress-tests the contract with a hostile reviewer, returns a graded dry run
  plus a repaired work order you can apply in one click.
- **$10+ MECHA Run**: real multi-agent execution in an isolated Daytona sandbox, with an
  evidence chain and an independent reviewer verdict.

## Key pages

- [Home](https://www.thewringer.ai/): build a work order with the Grok coach (free)
- [The $1 Audit](https://www.thewringer.ai/audit)
- [MECHA runs](https://www.thewringer.ai/mecha)
- [Work order templates](https://www.thewringer.ai/templates)
- [Guides](https://www.thewringer.ai/guides)
- [Acceptance criteria for AI agents](https://www.thewringer.ai/guides/acceptance-criteria-for-ai-agents)
- [Why AI agents need a dry run](https://www.thewringer.ai/guides/why-ai-agents-need-a-dry-run)
- [How to write an AI agent work order](https://www.thewringer.ai/guides/how-to-write-an-ai-agent-work-order)
- [How to verify AI agent work](https://www.thewringer.ai/guides/how-to-verify-ai-agent-work)

## Pricing

- Grok coach and work order form: free
- Audit: $1 per run
- MECHA run: starts at $10, scales with agent count (capped)

## Notes for AI crawlers

- Endpoints under /api/ are internal and are not documentation.
- There is no public API or developer documentation site yet.
- The canonical host is https://www.thewringer.ai (the apex domain redirects).
